biggest_catch: $7.50 minimum trade value means you need 2-3 textbooks (or equivalent) - a single book alone usually can't complete an order.
catches: Quotes are demand-based and can change; misjudged condition reduces the payout on arrival.
US-only service; international shipping not supported.
Older editions get offers only if there's current demand - many textbooks get no quote at all.
Bank transfer/PayPal are fastest; checks take 5-7 days.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; 100% free prepaid shipping label; ~15-30 min active (ISBN scan, pack, ship).

c1.evidence: Official FAQ on sellbackyourbook.com: payment processed within 2-5 business days after receipt and verification; method timings stated.

c2.evidence: Free prepaid shipping label; no fees.

c3.evidence: Fully mail-in: ISBN quote online, prepaid label, FedEx/USPS drop or free courier pickup.

demand_side: The venue is sellbackyourbook.com itself (the buyer). Demand side = their used-textbook resale operation. Instant quotes appear on-site when you enter/scan an ISBN - offers are based on current demand for that title plus condition/edition. You reach it today at sellbackyourbook.com - no account needed to price. You get 'picked' by accepting the quote once you hit the $7.50 minimum; they email the prepaid label and pay after verification.
eligibility: Anyone who owns textbooks (or sellable books) - primarily US; needs $7.50 in trade value to complete an order.
maximize: Scan all ISBNs to clear the $7.50 minimum; pick bank transfer or PayPal (2-3 days) over check (5-7 days); sell earlier in the semester cycle when demand/prices are higher.
notes: Textbook buyback lane: ValoreBooks already taken (R0368), Amazon trade-in taken (R0369), BookScouter rejected as aggregator (R7060). SellBackYourBook is an actual buyer with stated payout timing.

payout_value_note: Per book; varies by title demand, edition, and condition (e.g. a novel ~$1, a medical textbook set ~$100+) - total depends on which titles you own.

steps: Go to sellbackyourbook.com and enter or scan your textbooks' ISBNs for instant quotes.
Accept quotes once your total reaches the $7.50 minimum trade value.
They provide a free prepaid shipping label; pack the books.
Drop at any FedEx or USPS location, or request free courier pickup for larger orders.
They receive and verify the books; payment is processed within 2-5 business days.
Choose bank transfer or PayPal for fastest receipt (2-3 days); check takes 5-7 days.
timing: Instant quotes; ship; payment processed within 2-5 business days after receipt and verification.
what_gets_accepted: Textbooks and other sellable books in acceptable condition (no water damage, missing pages, torn covers); older editions only if demand exists; ex-library markings may be rejected or reduced.
when_cash_arrives: Payment processed within 2-5 business days after they receive and verify your books: bank transfer and PayPal fastest (2-3 days), checks 5-7 days.
who_qualifies: A human who owns physical textbooks and can mail them - the buyer needs your actual books; AI cannot own or ship them.
work_available: Always available - instant ISBN quote tool on site.
